nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Installs signal handlers that only set a quit flag, then calls XBMC_Run(true)

nodes.label: XBMC_Run()
nodes.desc: Bootstrap order: Create(), CreateGUI(), Initialize(), then the blocking g_application.Run()

nodes.label: CApplication::Create()
nodes.desc: Registers services in CServiceBroker and calls avformat_network_init() long before any GUI exists

nodes.label: CApplication::Run()
nodes.desc: while (!m_bStop) RunIteration(); the one loop everything else negotiates with

nodes.label: CApplication::RunIteration()
nodes.desc: Fixed rhythm per frame: Process(), FrameMove(true, renderGUI), Render()

nodes.label: CApplication::Process()
nodes.desc: Dispatches window-thread messages, pumps script threads, drains the app messenger; ProcessSlow() every 500ms

nodes.label: CApplication::FrameMove()
nodes.desc: Input plus the external-call window: 2-10ms (80ms when idle) with the graphics lock dropped for Python

nodes.label: CApplication::Render()
nodes.desc: BeginRender(), the GUI layer, then RenderEx() for the video layer

nodes.label: CApplicationMessenger::ProcessMessages()
nodes.desc: The TMSG_* queue every other thread posts into, drained only on the GUI thread

nodes.label: CServiceBroker
nodes.desc: Service locator: GetGUI(), GetInputManager(), GetAppMessenger() are all read per frame

nodes.label: CGUIWindowManager::Process()
nodes.desc: Advances and animates the active skin window

nodes.label: CGUIWindowManager::Render()
nodes.desc: Draws skin controls; even fullscreen video leaves this path available

nodes.label: CInputManager::HandleKey()
nodes.desc: CButtonTranslator maps the key to a CAction on the window that has focus

nodes.label: XBPython::XBPython()
nodes.desc: Py_Initialize() runs in this constructor; the xbmc/xbmcgui/xbmcvfs modules are imported up front

nodes.label: CPythonInvoker::execute()
nodes.desc: PyThreadState_New under XBPython's main interpreter, then Py_NewInterpreter for an isolated script

nodes.label: AddonClass (legacy API)
nodes.desc: Hand-written C++ classes (Window, Control, Dialog...) that the Python modules expose

nodes.label: AddonModuleXbmcgui.i
nodes.desc: SWIG interface file that generates the xbmcgui module bindings

nodes.label: CApplicationPlayer::OpenFile()
nodes.desc: CreatePlayer() from the factory, then forwards the CFileItem to the chosen IPlayer

nodes.label: CPlayerCoreFactory
nodes.desc: Picks the player implementation per item type

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::OpenFile()
nodes.desc: Constructor is CThread("VideoPlayer") and CreatePlayers() builds the per-stream engines

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::Process()
nodes.desc: while (!m_bAbortRequest): open input, open demuxer, default streams, HandleMessages(), ReadPacket()

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::OpenInputStream()
nodes.desc: Creates the CDVDInputStream for file/network/disc sources

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::OpenDemuxStream()
nodes.desc: CDVDFactoryDemuxer::CreateDemuxer() returns the ffmpeg demuxer wrapper

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::ReadPacket()
nodes.desc: Pulls one DemuxPacket and routes it to the matching stream queue

nodes.label: CVideoPlayer::HandleMessages()
nodes.desc: Consumes seeks, pauses and stream switches posted from the GUI thread

nodes.label: CVideoPlayerVideo::Process()
nodes.desc: video_thread: GetMessage() from its queue, decode, OutputPicture() to the render manager

nodes.label: CVideoPlayerVideo::OpenStream()
nodes.desc: CDVDFactoryCodec::CreateVideoCodec(), then Create() spawns the thread

nodes.label: CDVDDemuxFFmpeg::Open()
nodes.desc: avformat_open_input() then avformat_find_stream_info() over the Kodi input stream

nodes.label: CDVDDemuxFFmpeg::Read()
nodes.desc: av_read_frame() repackaged as a DemuxPacket

nodes.label: CDVDFactoryCodec::CreateVideoCodec()
nodes.desc: Tries hardware decoders first, falls back to the ffmpeg software codec

nodes.label: CDVDVideoCodecFFmpeg::Open()
nodes.desc: avcodec_find_decoder(), avcodec_alloc_context3(), avcodec_open2()

nodes.label: CDVDVideoCodecFFmpeg::Decode()
nodes.desc: avcodec_send_packet() / avcodec_receive_frame() on every video packet

nodes.label: CRenderManager::FrameMove()
nodes.desc: Owns the decoded picture queue that the GUI render pass later composites

edges.label: script body runs on this API
